title: diplazium khullarii
intro: Diplazium khullarii, commonly known as Himalayan shield fern, is a type of medicinal fern species. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Diplazium khullarii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, and anti-microbial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
